verdict.rationale: YPOG is a law and tax advisory firm offering transactions, funds, corporate, notary and filing services, not a software platform, so issuing scoped API credentials for an agent is a category error for this kind of offering. The evidence shows no API surface: the llms.txt and OpenAPI probes all returned 404. The legal-tech mention and the software-supported transparency-register unit are internal service tooling, not a documented API that users can issue credentials against, so they do not make the axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
